reason: The rate looks decent on paper, but I won't put a client's sale on a provider I haven't tested, and I'd still line it up against my other two quotes first. Most of my clients' customers answer on WhatsApp anyway, which costs nothing.
objection: The sender name only gets approved after signup with no timeline, and Sinhala messages can eat two or three credits, so the real per-message cost for my clients could be well above 0.58 and might not be live in time for the sale.
would_change_my_mind: A guaranteed sender-name approval time (like within 24 hours) plus a few hundred free test credits so I can check delivery to Dialog, Mobitel and Hutch numbers before I bill a client for it.
